name: AIShield Security Scanner
description: Open-source, local-first AI Agent security scanner and trust authority. Scans MCP servers and agents for tool poisoning, prompt injection, secret leakage, and supply-chain risk; covers OWASP MCP Top 10 and OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (ASI01-ASI10).

skills.name: Security Scan
skills.description: Scan an MCP server or agent description for 201 risk categories (OWASP MCP Top 10 + Agentic AI Top 10).
examples: Scan this MCP server tool list for prompt-injection and tool-poisoning risk

skills.name: Agentic AI Audit
skills.description: Audit an AI agent against OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (ASI01-ASI10): goal hijack, tool misuse, identity abuse, supply chain, code execution, memory poisoning, inter-agent comms, cascading failure, human-agent trust, rogue agents.
examples: Audit my agent's delegation chain for ASI03 identity and ASI07 inter-agent risks

skills.name: Trust Score Lookup
skills.description: Return an agent's AIShield Trust Score (0-100) and certification level from the Agent Registry.
examples: What is the trust score of did:aishield:7f3a2b1c9d4e5f6a8b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c?
